title: Chilli Paneer
subtitle: Tangy, spicy and a little sweet — shallow-fried paneer and bell peppers in an Indo-Chinese sauce.
protein: ~17–19g protein per adult serving — from paneer

method.title: Prep and coat the paneer
items: Dice {@bell-pepper} into 1-inch pieces and finely chop {@ginger}
In a mixing bowl, toss {@paneer} with {@salt} and {@cornstarch}
If it's too dry, sprinkle a little water so the starch coats each cube evenly
Mix {@water} with {@cornstarch-slurry}; set the slurry aside

method.label: Toddler — set her cubes aside (before chili and pepper)
items: Move {@paneer:toddler} of the coated cubes to a small plate — they get fried first, plain

method.title: Shallow fry
items: Heat {@oil} in a large frying pan; fry {@paneer:toddler|her plain cubes} first until golden on each side, then lift onto a plate for the toddler
Fry the rest until golden brown on each side
Lift onto a plate lined with paper towel; keep the oil left in the pan

method.title: Make the sauce
items: Reheat the same pan; add {@hing} and {@ginger} and sauté a few seconds
Keep the flame high so the peppers char at the edges rather than steam
Add {@soy}, {@ketchup} and {@sugar}; mix and turn the flame to low-medium

method.label: Toddler — her sauce (before the chili sauce)
items: Toss her fried paneer with {=1 tbsp} of the sauce and a few soft bell pepper pieces, cut small

method.title: Toss and finish
items: Add the fried paneer; mix well, then stir in the slurry {from Step 1} — the sauce turns thick for a dry chilli paneer (add more water for gravy)
Turn off the heat; garnish with {@coriander} and serve immediately

method.label: Tip
method.text: Many red chili sauces and ketchups aren't Jain — use no-onion-no-garlic ones. The chili powder and pepper now go on after her cubes are pulled, and the chili sauce after her spoon of sauce. Air fryer option: toss the coated cubes with 1 tsp of the oil and cook in the Ninja Crispi at 360°F for 8–10 min, shaking once. Best in a wide frying pan on high heat so the peppers char rather than steam.
